title: CORE-6994 · SITEWIDE: button hover colours — blue lift + search darken
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6994](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6994)

## Half the ticket is right; the other half has the wrong premise

| Ticket claim | Verdict |
|---|---|
| "all blue buttons" hover wrong | **TRUE** — every cyan button hovers `rgb(0,156,200)` (darker) on the clone; live goes `rgb(23,204,255)` (lighter). 5/5 pages, both viewports. |
| "search green" | **FALSE as stated.** The search button is green at rest and green on hover on **both** sites — never a wrong hue. The real defect is direction: live *darkens* to `rgb(0,131,88)`, the clone *lightens* to `rgb(0,208,139)`. |
| implied: green buttons generally wrong | **FALSE — already correct.** Buy Now, Register Now, Get Started, Create an account all hover `rgb(0,208,139)` on both sites. `--surface-cta-success-hover` deliberately untouched. |

## The decisive evidence

`#009cc8` — the value behind `--surface-brand-cyan-hover` — occurs **zero times** in live's 300 KB stylesheet:

```
#009cc8    0 occurrences
#17ccff    2 occurrences   <- live's .Button--btnSecondary:hover
#008358    2 occurrences   <- live's .Namecheck--namecheck__button:hover/:focus/:active
#00d08b    8 occurrences
```

So that token was invented. The correct value already sat two lines below it as
`--surface-brand-cyan-lift: rgb(23 204 255)`.

**The control that proves the fix value:** the two blue buttons on `/contact-us/` already
matched live before this PR, because those call sites passed `tone="cyanLift"`. That made
`cyan` and `cyanLift` two names for what should always have been one thing, so `cyanLift` is
removed and its two call sites moved to `cyan`.

## Verified — same page, same selectors, real mouse hover

| button (`/` @1440) | live hover | after |
|---|---|---|
| **Search** | `0,131,88` | **`0,131,88`** ✅ |
| **Compare Packages** | `23,204,255` | **`23,204,255`** ✅ |
| **Our Customer Reviews** | `23,204,255` | **`23,204,255`** ✅ |
| **Our Non-Resident Packages** | `23,204,255` | **`23,204,255`** ✅ |
| Buy Now | `0,208,139` | `0,208,139` ✅ unchanged |
| Get Started | `0,208,139` | `0,208,139` ✅ unchanged |
| Learn More | `0,208,139` | `0,208,139` ✅ unchanged |
| Register Now | `0,208,139` | `0,208,139` ✅ unchanged |

The green rows are the do-not-regress set: they matched before and still match.

## The search button needed a new token

Live has a dedicated override that darkens only the name-check control
(`.Namecheck--namecheck__button:hover/:focus/:active { background-color:#008358 }`), and no
token for `rgb(0 131 88)` existed. Reusing `--surface-cta-success-hover` for it would have
broken the four green buttons above, so `--surface-cta-search-hover` is minted and applied to
the two copies of that control (`NameCheck`, and `LandingHero`'s hero copy) across
hover/focus/active, matching live's selector list.

## Deliberately NOT in this PR

The investigation turned up three further divergences outside the ticket's scope. Each is a
separate defect and I have left them alone rather than widen this PR:

1. `/compare-packages/` Buy Now and Read More have **no hover state at all** — `ComparePackageTable.styles.ts:50` and `:52` contain no `hover:` class.
2. Home package-grid Read More: hover grey `rgb(245,245,245)` vs live `rgb(242,242,242)`, and rest border `rgb(218,218,218)` vs live `#ccc` — `PackageGridCard.styles.ts:31`.
3. `hover:bg` without `hover:border` on two green CTAs, so the 1px ring does not move with the fill — visible on **Register Now** in the table above (border stays `0,182,122` where live moves to `0,208,139`). `FourSteps.styles.ts:35`.

Also noted, not colour-related: the clone's search button has `border-width: 0` where live has
`1px`, so its box is 2px smaller in each axis. And the name-check **retry/error** button could
not be measured without a failing submission — live uses a flat `rgb(200,127,10)` there against
the clone's `opacity-90`, likely a further divergence.

## Safety

`grep` confirms `--surface-brand-cyan-hover` had exactly four references — the declaration plus
the three consumers patched here — so deleting it leaves nothing dangling. Every other consumer
of `--surface-cta-success-hover` (`FourSteps`, `ui/button`, `PackageGridCard`, `CtaLink.success`,
and NameCheck's post-result CTA, which live keeps at `#00d08b`) is untouched.

## Checks

- `bun run ts` clean · `bun run build` green
- hover measured with a real `mouse.move` and `:hover` asserted true on every row, live vs after
acceptanceCriteria: Cyan buttons hover to rgb(23,204,255) sitewide, matching live.
Name-check search button darkens to rgb(0,131,88) on hover/focus/active, matching live.
Green CTAs still hover to rgb(0,208,139) — no regression.
Three out-of-scope divergences (compare-packages no hover, package-grid Read More greys, missing hover:border) filed separately.
